notes: Space is now a separate Delay and Reverb, side by side, each with a draggable XY tail point.
Reverb types: Room, Spring, Plate and Hall. Delay adds Ping Pong, Stereo and Mono.
New HAAS stereo-width slider on each oscillator.
Scream filter is now a formant yell. Old sessions keep the classic Scream.
Master can now be modulated, and the preset bar has a new menu (Init, Save, Load).
